sections.text_helper: Section 28.8.9 "SAES initialization vector register 0 (SAES_IVR0)" in chapter 28 (Secure AES coprocessor (SAES)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 884.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x020
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 IVI[31:0]: Initialization vector input, bits [31:0]
SAES_IVRx registers store the 128-bit initialization vector or the nonce, depending on the chaining
mode selected. This value is updated by hardware after each computation round (when applicable).
Write to this register is ignored when EN bit is set in SAES_CR register
